Merrig, also known as Maioc, provides a thorn collected from the short-grass plains of semi-arid central Endor. The plant remains difficult to find in its habitat.

The thorn is prepared as an infusion or decoction. One dose each day for ten days raises Appearance and Presence by 5 points each. Use often becomes addictive after two weeks; withdrawal causes a loss of Constitution as well as reductions in Appearance and Presence. The catalogue records a significant risk of dependence.
